note: Westpac, which has the island's branch (Canberra Place, BSB 036-189, in its own branch locator): the Westpac Choice everyday account costs 5 dollars a month, waived in a month with at least 2,000 dollars deposited or for a holder under 41; the waivers for a full-time tertiary student and for a customer new to Australia in the first twelve months aren't written.
